background: TEST DATA. The parcel-desk prototype may need to show the cash amount on its first screen; nobody has watched a courier use the flow yet.
objectives: Find out whether a courier can take a cash payment without help
Find out where couriers look for the total to collect
researchQuestions: Can a courier reach the payment step from their route?
Where do couriers expect to see the amount they must collect?
decision: Whether the amount moves to the first screen in the next build.
methodRationale: A task-based test on the clickable prototype shows what people do; a survey can only show what they say.

recruitment.incentive: A voucher, paid after the session
